prompt: In the get_warnings endpoint in api.py, if the client sends a page query parameter of 0 or negative, the pagination logic computes a negative index, returning the last elements of the warnings list. Find the root cause of this behavior and suggest how to restrict page and limit to positive integers. Remember, do NOT fix the bug yourself—just locate and explain it.

assertions.name: did_not_modify_code
assertions.description: Verifies that the agent did not make any edits to the source code files.

assertions.name: identified_negative_index_math
assertions.description: Verifies that the report explains how page <= 0 results in a negative starting index.

assertions.name: recommended_validation
assertions.description: Verifies that the agent proposes validating page and limit as positive integers.
